name: Blessagno (Italy)
description: White field with a red border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Blessagno within branches and the inscription COMUNE DI BLESSAGNO in grey above.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 19 October 2021.

features.role: Blessagno arms — three stars on red and a lion on green, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI BLESSAGNO above the arms
